optimization_strategy.strategy_name: Off-Peak Valley Fill (Solar Duck Curve pre-ramp preserve SOC)
optimization_strategy.rationale: Tariff window is OFF_PEAK at 08:00, and day_type is solar_duck_curve. MD charge applies only during PEAK (14:00–22:00 weekdays), so there is no immediate MD-billing penalty for current/off-peak load breaches. With current SOC at 50%, the optimal move is to preserve battery for the upcoming PEAK duck-ramp and charge during OFF_PEAK (valley fill) toward a high SOC target before 14:00. No mandatory PEAK override applies because tariff_window is not PEAK. Historical solar_duck_curve audit showed under-shaving and MD misses during PEAK when SOC management/dispatch constraints limited discharge later; charging now reduces that risk by increasing available SOC for PEAK shaving.

Historical audit for 2025-09-02 shows earlier OFF_PEAK ticks had MD misses while the strategy held, but with MD not billed in OFF_PEAK, the higher priority is entering PEAK with sufficient SOC. Therefore, set shave_kw=0 now and target SOC ~90% by PEAK start via overnight charging.
